item.title: [News] Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence
item.description: Google DeepMind has announced Gemini 4 Argon, the next evolution in its Gemini series, featuring advanced multimodal capabilities and deeper contextual understanding. This model promises higher accuracy in natural language and vision tasks, positioning it as a potential backend for next-gen AI services.

item.title: [News] Forecasting space weather risks on power grids
item.description: Microsoft Research has developed a machine learning system that can predict space-weather events affecting power grids 30-60 minutes in advance. The technology promises earlier mitigation of power disruptions and GPS degradation caused by solar storms.

item.title: [News] Introducing SynthID Bio
item.description: Google DeepMind has unveiled SynthID Bio, a prototype system that embeds watermarks into AI-generated proteins without compromising their biological function. This technology could enable traceability and authenticity verification for computationally designed biomolecules.

item.title: [News] Turn Energy Efficiency Into Strategic Advantage
item.description: An MIT Sloan study explores how executives use digital technologies to improve energy efficiency and sustainability, surveying 39 leaders across 10 countries and 360 Swiss manufacturing firms. The research focuses on strategy rather than specific AI tools.

item.title: [News] New Microsoft data innovations unlock what only your business knows
item.description: Microsoft has unveiled new data‑centric AI capabilities that aim to extract value from the unique knowledge embedded in each organization’s data assets. These innovations promise to enhance AI models by incorporating proprietary business context, potentially reshaping how enterprises build and deploy intelligent solutions.
